what_it_does: This chip is a 2.5D system built from 20 smaller chips (chiplets) stacked vertically, designed to run multiple AI inference workloads simultaneously. The core innovation is flexible resource allocation: the system has 300MB of memory distributed across chiplets and provides 20 terabits per second of bandwidth (the interconnect between chiplets), but different workloads need different splits—some need more memory, others need more bandwidth. Instead of permanently allocating resources, configurations are tailored at assembly time: a deep learning model gets more compute and memory chiplets, while a vision model gets more bandwidth-optimized chiplets. The system also mixes different manufacturing technologies: each chiplet can use the best process node available from different foundries for its specific task (compute chiplets use cutting-edge nodes, memory chiplets use proven older nodes).
